narrative.intro: Massachusetts Institute of Technology obligated $1.1B in FY2026 to date. Massachusetts Institute of Technology received 27 awards in the period. Massachusetts Institute of Technology had an average award size of $41.1M. Massachusetts Institute of Technology obligations were down 23.1% year over year. Massachusetts Institute of Technology obligations by fiscal year show $1.1B in FY21, $1.1B in FY22, $1.4B in FY23, $1.5B in FY24, $1.4B in FY25, and $1.1B in FY26. Massachusetts Institute of Technology top markets in FY2026 to date are Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) at $961M and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $148M. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values.
